Yeh Meri Soch Meri Fiqr Yeh Mera Qirdar,
Jisme Shaamil Hai Faqat Logon Hussaini Afqaar,
Yeh Meri Azmat O Jurrat Yeh Shujaat Meri,
Baisey Hazrat E Shabbir Mera Iftekhar....

Haq Suna Haq Hai Kaha Haq Ka Kiya Hai Parchaar,
Seerat E Aale Mohammad Se Mila Hai Yeh Sheyar,
Zulm Ke Aage Kabhi Sar Na Jhukaya Maine,
Karbalai Hoon Haqeeqat Hai Meri Yeh Guftaar...

Deen E Islam Ki Azmat Ka Bharam Rakhna Hai,
Misl E Shabbir Mujhe Iska Difa Karna Hai,
Anch Aney Nahi Deni Hai Koi Bhi Ispar,
Maine Jeedari Se Is Raah Pe Hi Marna Hai...

Sirf Lafzon Se Mohabbat Nahi Ki Jaati Hai,
Marefat Ishq Salika Humne Sikhlati Hai,
Jab Aqeede Pe Parakh Le Koi Imaa'n Apna,
Phir Shahadat Usey Har Ghaam Nazar Aati Hai...

Lashkar E Kufr Se Hurr Banke Nikal Ne Ke Liye,
Waqt Ke Maula Ki Pehchan Agar Hojaye,
Baat Qaafi Hai Yeh Taqdeer Badal Ne Ke Liye...

Maqsad E Deen Ki Tashheer Ibadat Meri,
Karbala Walon Ka Rasta Hai Mera Bhi Rasta,
Mujhko Malum Hai Isme Hai Shifa'at Meri...

Daur E Haq Hai Yeh Isme Toh Hai Mitna Baatil,
Nauke Naiza Pe Agar Chadta Hai Sar Chad Jaye,
Marziye Khaliq E Akbar Ko Hai Karna Haasil...

Hukm Jis Raah Pe Chalne Ka Woh Dein Uspe Chalun,
Nayab E Maula Pe Yeh Jaan Fida Ho Meri,
Inki Marzi Ke Bina Kaam Koi Bhi Na Karun...

Joh Bahattar (72) Ne Kiya Kaam Wohi Karna Hai,
Karke Hayi Haath Minna Zilla Ka Sheyar Buland,
Aaj Ki Karbobala Mein Yeh Qadam Rakhna Hai...
